verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented payout or balance-transaction API and no reconciliation of bank deposits to underlying charges. The only nearby item is a CLI that can 'operate... reports', which never says the reports cover payouts, settlements or deposit-to-charge matching, so it is an adjacent feature rather than this capability. The MCP server docs cover documentation search, test users and webhooks, not reconciliation data.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payout and balance-transaction data via the API and reconcile each bank deposit to its underlying charges
